Aqui a gente conecta o mundo


A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?


Você terá um impacto significativo tanto no presente quanto no futuro das nossas soluções, com visibilidade em toda a empresa. Além disso, trabalhará com um time de alta performance composto por Devs, UI/UX, Testers, Arquitetos, entre outros. Buscamos um profissional experiente com habilidades de liderança e excelente comunicação, que seja capaz de contribuir não apenas com habilidades técnicas avançadas, mas também a capacidade de influenciar positivamente a equipe e os projetos em ambientes ágeis. Comprometido com a resolução de problemas complexos, a otimização de processos e a melhoria contínua em projetos de grande escala.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e produtos utilizando tecnologias como ReactJs, TypeScript, orientado por documentação Swagger.
  • Realizar manutenção evolutiva e corretiva, além da implementação de novas features, em aplicações que utilizam OpenSearch Dashboards.
  • Participar de iniciativas técnicas, garantindo a implementação de boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar na manutenção, melhoria contínua e evolução de bibliotecas internas, códigos de terceiros e do Design System da empresa.
    Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com UI/UX, testers, arquitetos e outros stakeholders para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência avançada em JavaScript com ReactJS.
  • Proficiência em front-end (HTML5, CSS3/SASS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Bootstrap e design responsivo).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos princípios e padrões de design de interação e usabilidade (design centrado no usuário).
  • Experiência na integração do front-end com o back-end através de REST APIs e AJAX.
  • Conhecimento sobre Swagger.
  • Proficiência em Git e experiência com workflows colaborativos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Redux e outras ferramentas de gerenciamento de estado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento (Webpack, Npm, Babel, rsbuild, Module Federation, Monorepo).
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários front end (Jest e React Testing Library).-
  • Experiência prática com bibliotecas CSS in JS (Styled-components).
  • Familiaridade com React Aria Components para padrões de composição de componentes e estilização.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, AWS, SSR.
  • Experiência em arquitetura de micro frontends.
  • Certificações relevantes na área de desenvolvimento front-end.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil Queremos você em nossa equipe

title: Route to Market Data Specialist
description:
• The role is responsible for conducting the analytics processes and methodologies that support key Route to Market (RTM) initiatives aimed at identifying opportunities to optimize the distribution network and operational RTM strategies. These projects are based on RTM assessments that form part of an ongoing analytics cycle, which begins with a comprehensive RTM and performance analysis across business units. Based on these findings, priority projects are scoped, planned, and executed.
  • This position will lead the development and management of the RTM analytics foundation, which underpins performance diagnostics and preliminary network evaluations. Once a network optimization initiative is launched, this role will be accountable for the preparation and data collection phase and will provide support during model calibration and optimization.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Proven experience in Supply Chain or Commercial Analytics roles, with prior involvement in data-driven projects.

  • Strong analytical capabilities and proficiency with tools such as Power BI, Excel, Piton, Llamasoft, and other modeling/optimization platforms.

  • Experience in previous analytics projects related with data automation, optimization model or analytics models development.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and ability to interact with stakeholders across different levels and geographies.

  • Ownership, autonomy, and resilience to navigate evolving priorities and shifting environment while still being able to focus on deliver the commitments.

  • Fluency in English.

  • Continuously monitor the analytics process to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and efficiency gains—allowing greater focus on insight generation and decision support.

Requisitos e qualificações
You'll have the potential to transform our business and your career, while getting the support and mentorship you need to succeed. We're a meritocracy, with plenty of room for growth and development, so you know your hard work will be rewarded. We encourage you to think big and go after your goals. You'll get to be creative, work with international teams so you can build a global network and have direct control over your career and where it takes you. We are building a team that's more supportive, more inclusive, and more collaborative. A team that's diverse in back-ground, skills, and experience.

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de 50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS

Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech, hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Com escritórios espalhados por países como Estados Unidos, México, Índia, Argentina e Brasil, estamos conectados a uma rede global de inovação e tecnologia para transformar a Ambev em uma plataforma que conecta pessoas e o ecossistema.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer
description:
Toradex
is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

We develop Torizon, which is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description
As an Embedded Linux Engineer, you will be part of the R&D team developing our Torizon OS: an easy-and-ready-to-use Linux-based operating system supported on Toradex hardware and 3rd party hardware.

Your focus will be on maintaining our open source Ope Embedded/Yocto layers, as well as keeping close contact with the R&D team responsible for maintaining Toradex BSP. You will help maintaining and expanding our automated build and tests to guarantee the high level of quality of Toradex software.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and add support Torizon OS for different SoC platforms (NXP, TI and more to come)
  • Keep close contact with other teams inside R&D to guarantee Toradex's full stack approach
  • Maintain and expand automated build and test cases for Torizon OS
  • Continuously improve DevOps best practices

Desired Candidate Profile:

  • Mandatory:

  • Experience OpenEmbedded/Yocto and its best practices

  • Experience in Embedded Linux and Embedded Systems
  • Advanced Linux knowledge
  • Intermediate Docker knowledge

  • Proactive and communicate

  • Nice to have:

  • Contributions to FOSS projects

  • Contributions to Debian

  • Willing to learn:

  • How to debug OS/embedded system/software in various languages

  • Best practices on build automation and test setup (CI/CD, DevOps)
  • Writing automated tests

What we offer:

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Garantir a definição, evolução e aplicação da governança de APIs, promovendo padrões arquiteturais, segurança, escalabilidade e consistência, apoiando clientes e times na construção de ecossistemas de APIs sustentáveis e alinhados às estratégias de negócio.

  • Elaborar diretrizes arquiteturais e API Style Guides para padronização de modelos, contratos e boas práticas.
  • Conduzir avaliações de maturidade de APIs, diagnósticos técnicos e recomendações de evolução arquitetural.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na criação de APIs consistentes, seguras e aderentes aos padrões corporativos.
  • Definir e revisar políticas de segurança, versionamento, ciclo de vida, monitoração e observabilidade de APIs.
  • Participar de discussões estratégicas com stakeholders para garantir alinhamento entre negócio, tecnologia e governança.
    Contribuir para disseminação de boas práticas por meio de workshops, documentações e frameworks internos.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência sólida com Arquitetura de Software, integrações e design de APIs REST (desejável conhecimento em GraphQL e eventos).
  • Forte conhecimento em API Management (preferencialmente Sensedia API Platform).
  • Domínio de práticas de governança:
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação .Net e Java.
  • Versionamento
  • Segurança (OAuth 2.0, JWT, OpenID Connect)
  • Políticas e SLAs
  • Ciclo de vida e catálogo de APIs
  • Métricas e observabilidade
  • Vivência com arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços, mensageria e patterns de integração.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Capacidade de criação e manutenção de Guia de Estilo (API Style Guide), modelos de contrato e padrões arquiteturais.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência prévia com Sensedia API Platform.
  • Certificações em arquitetura (ex.: TOGAF, AWS, Azure).
  • Vivência com governança corporativa em empresas de grande porte.

We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Toradex is a leading provider of embedded computing solutions, specializing in powerful, reliable, and easy-to-use hardware and software for IoT, industrial automation, medical devices, and other verticals. With a focus on high-quality, reliability, ease-of-use, and a strong developer experience, Toradex offers a range of System on Modules (SoMs), accompanying accessories and carrier boards, customization services, a full-stack software offering facilitating cyber regulations compliance, and much more. Headquartered in Switzerland, with offices across the globe, Toradex is committed to empowering developers and businesses by delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that reduce complexity and accelerate time to market.

Job Description


As a Product Marketing Manager at Toradex, you will play a key role in shaping how the market perceives our cutting-edge embedded computing solutions. You'll lead initiatives to build awareness and drive adoption by combining strategic product positioning with creative storytelling. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Design, you will help to execute go-to-market strategies, craft clear and differentiated messaging, and collaborate to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling narratives and impactful campaigns. This role blends analytical thinking and creative vision, requiring the ability to connect engineering depth with market relevance, as well as the skill to develop high-performing content that drives awareness, engagement, and growth across multiple channels.

Goals


Drive awareness and accelerate adoption of Toradex products by shaping market perception, building strong narratives, and ensuring consistent, impactful communication across all touchpoints, from technical storytelling to creative execution.

How

  • Efficiently sharing positioning and messaging for new Toradex products and aligning the company and customers around that.
  • Creating narratives that communicate the value and differentiation of our products to developers, engineers, and decision-makers.
  • Partnering closely with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation and Design to translate technical capabilities into compelling stories.
  • Ensuring messaging consistency across website, campaigns, events, and collateral.
  • Monitoring and analyzing marketing performance to continuously refine both positioning and creative execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Helping to create a clear and differentiated product story that resonates with target audiences and aligns internal teams on the "why" behind our products.
  • Content Creation: Act as a Creative Strategist, translating product messaging into creative concepts and storytelling frameworks. Create copy for key assets such as product pages, digital ads, launch materials, presentations, blogs, and videos to drive awareness of new products and features across different audiences and channels.
  • Go-to-Market Support: Collaborate on product launches by defining messaging frameworks, coordinating enablement materials, and ensuring cross-team alignment.
  • Campaign Collaboration: Partner with Paid Media, Social, Product Marketing, and Design teams to align messaging, visuals, and campaign objectives and to ensure campaigns accurately reflect product positioning and market insights.
  • Market Feedback Loop: Gather insights from campaigns and customers to refine messaging and guide content priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Product, Sales, and Demand Generation to ensure GTM alignment and consistency across regions and verticals.

Desired Candidate Profile


Must Have:

  • Between 3 to 5 years of professional experience in Product Marketing, Marketing Management, or Creative Strategy within a technology or B2B context
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a proven background working with technical products
  • Strong English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Understanding of B2B technology marketing in global markets
  • Proven ability to create content for both technical and business audiences
  • Experience crafting ad copy, creative concepts, and performance-driven campaigns for both awareness and lead generation
  • Understands paid marketing and social media dynamics, and how to adapt creative to maximize reach and engagement across platforms
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to measure and iterate on marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborative working style, comfortable coordinating across multiple teams and functions
  • Passionate and enthusiastic about talking about new, cutting-edge technology devices
  • Proven ability to lead by influence

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in Toradex's target verticals such as Healthcare, Industrial Automation, Transportation, Smart City, or Test & Measurement
  • Familiarity with Embedded Systems or related hardware/software technologies

What we offer

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Estagiário de gestão
description:
**A Les Inteligência de Negócios é uma holding de desenvolvimento empresarial focada em identificar oportunidades, desenvolver negócios e gerar resultados sustentáveis. Nosso trabalho é transformar intenção em estrutura: organizar processos, criar controles, acompanhar prioridades e dar ritmo à execução.

Estamos em uma fase de estruturação e consolidação. Isso significa que parte das rotinas, controles e padrões ainda está sendo construída e aprimorada. Por isso, buscamos pessoas proativas e organizadas, com interesse genuíno em aprender gestão na prática, contribuir com melhorias contínuas e atuar com disciplina e responsabilidade.

Procuramos um(a) estagiário(a) de gestão para apoiar diretamente a organização da empresa e a condução de rotinas administrativas e gerenciais. Entre as atividades do dia a dia estão o acompanhamento de tarefas e prazos, a organização de informações e documentos, a atualização de controles em planilhas, a coleta e consolidação de dados e a elaboração de relatórios e resumos gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão. Também fará parte do trabalho apoiar a implementação e a melhoria de processos internos junto à liderança.

O estágio é em regime híbrido, com base em Campinas/SP, permitindo parte das atividades em formato remoto.

Carga horária: 4 horas diárias (20 horas semanais).

Bolsa auxílio: R$ 900,00.

Requisitos: estar cursando graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas; ter organização, disciplina e senso de responsabilidade com prazos e qualidade; boa comunicação escrita e verbal; familiaridade com ferramentas de escritório, especialmente Excel ou Google Sheets, além de Word/Docs e PowerPoint/Slides.

Diferenciais: interesse por rotinas de gestão, organização de processos e acompanhamento de projetos; noções básicas ou curiosidade sobre metodologias de organização (como Kanban); facilidade para aprender rapidamente e registrar padrões de trabalho (checklists, modelos e rotinas); conhecimento básico de idioma estrangeiro (não obrigatório).**

title: Sr. Software Engineer, C#/.NET
description:
Job Purpose and Impact

  • The Senior Professional, Software Engineering job designs, develops and maintains software applications and systems. With minimal supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to define, design and implement new software features to meet user needs and business goals, and upgrade existing software to improve performance and functionality through writing clean, efficient and scalable code and troubleshooting and debugging complex issues. This job also participates in code reviews to maintain high code quality and share knowledge with software engineering team members.

Key Accountabilities

  • SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT: Designs and develops high quality software solutions by writing clean, maintainable and efficient codes.
  • AUTOMATION: Leads the application of internal software deployment platform, methodologies and tools to automate the deployment process, ensuring smooth and reliable releases.
  • COLLABORATION: Partners with cross functional team of product managers, designers and different engineers to gather complex requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
  • TESTING & DEBUGGING: Writes and maintains complex unit tests and integration tests, and performs debugging to maintain the quality and performance of the software.
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Suggests options for improving the software development and deployment processes, and implements the approved standards to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • DOCUMENTATION: Builds and maintains comprehensive documentation for complex software applications, deployment processes and system configurations.
  • TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for complex issues with deployed applications to ensure minimal downtime and fast resolution.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming.
  • Experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit, Moq).
  • Familiarity with design patterns (e.g., Repository, Factory, Strategy).
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and SQL Server: writing queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and message-based systems.
  • Experience with relational databases and data access libraries (e.g., Entity Framework, Dapper).
  • Proficient in Git: branching, merging, pull requests, and version control workflows.
  • Fluent English level

title: Lead Project Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life.
The Control Systems Lead Project Engineer will act as the single point of contact for engineering on the project. You will develop a solid knowledge and experience with electrical and mechanical control systems for turbines. You will support coordinating technology resources for the application of the correct customer solution. In this role you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers to develop and implement custom solutions that supply the world with energy. Help design the solution, see it through manufacturing, and support commissioning at domestic and international customer sites. This is a great opportunity to expand your professional career and gain invaluable hands-on experience.

Job Description

What you'll do

  • Provide engineering support for retrofit control systems under the overall management responsibility of the project manager.  Be accountable for project deliverables, customer CTQ compliance, on-time schedule execution and team performance.
  • Apply electrical and mechanical engineering principles to analyze, propose, design, test, and troubleshoot control systems.
  • Help review contract documentation and customer specifications for technical impact.
  • Co-responsible for technical review and response to customer specifications. Provides support to commercial/sales organization to interpret requirements and define responses in proposals and Tables of Compliance.
  • Work alongside, receiving mentoring from, Senior Project Engineers.
  • Help design systems for interface to existing turbine control equipment, and evaluate all system components, requirements, and interactions.
  • Responsible to coordinate and co-lead technical design reviews of projects and to update and archive all required documentation.
  • Apply knowledge of industry practices and international standards to produce high-quality and cost-effective designs.
  • Support customer meetings, factory acceptance testing, and eventually installation and commissioning of control systems.
  • Frequently interact with customers and suppliers.
  • Demonstrated expertise in technical problem resolution, especially with regards to power plants operation.
  • Travel within the region up to 25% of the time

What you'll bring (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or related discipline.
  • Min. 5 years of experience in power application with turbine-generator control systems.

What will make you stand out:

  • Familiarity with GEV and non-GE turbines or non-GEV control systems.
  • Master's degree in a STEM field preferred
  • Experience in interfacing with all levels of GE internal and external customers (GE Vernova employees only).
  • Green Belt certified, or other lean training.
  • Familiarity with Control ST software suit.
  • Familiarity with power plant methods of communication and networking with DCS systems such as MODBUS.
  • Knowledge and experience with electrical and mechanical control systems.
  • Ability to support multiple projects simultaneously in a matrix management environment.
  • Organizational, analytical, and problem-solving ability and adept at communicating with several levels of the organization.
  • Influence, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Process discipline with sound analytical and statistical skills.
  • Strong customer service mindset.

About GE Gas Power

GE Gas Power engineer's cleaner, more accessible energy that people depend on, powering growth and prosperity for people everywhere. Our leading technologies produce a third of the world's electricity thanks to our talented people, who make gas work for our customers, stakeholders, and the world. Through relentless innovation and continuous partnership with our customers, we are building the energy technologies of the future and providing the cleaner, more efficient power people depend on today.

This position can be Offered on site at the Longmont, Colorado office additionally ; for U.S. based candidates only; for purposes of complying with U.S. pay transparency requirements, the base pay range for this position is $98, ,000.00 USD Annual. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate's experience, education, and skill set.

This position is also eligible for a variable 10% (AIP) performance bonus.

The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. This position will stay open on the career website until Jan 15th

title: Technical Software Consultant
description:
What Your New Challenge Will Look Like
As a Technical Software Consultant, you will play a role in supporting our clients in the supply chain and transportation & logistics disciplines. You will leverage your deep technical expertise to design, implement, and optimize software solutions, ensuring that they address complex business needs. Additionally, you will be responsible for managing project timelines, working cross-functionally with both technical and business teams to ensure successful project delivery.

  • Work closely with clients to understand their business needs, technical requirements, and goals. Translate those requirements into clear, actionable technical solutions architecture working closely with extended project teams and product development.
  • Lead the technical design and implementation of supply chain optimization software solutions for clients in the supply chain, transportation, and logistics discipline. Utilize industry best practices and cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, efficient systems.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior consultants and other team members. Ensure high-quality standards and technical excellence in all deliverables.
  • Oversee and manage project timelines, deliverables, and resources. Coordinate with stakeholders, both internal and client-side, to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to specification. Use project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) to track progress and manage risks.
  • Bring deep domain expertise in supply chain management, transportation, and logistics to provide insights into best practices and process improvements. Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, reduce costs, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Regularly communicate project progress, issues, and updates to senior management and clients. Act as the primary point of contact for technical questions and project escalations.
  • Oversee testing phases to ensure that all software implementations meet functional and technical requirements. Collaborate with QA teams to validate system functionality, identify defects, and drive resolution.
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development, supply chain management, and logistics. Share knowledge and insights with clients and internal team members to drive continuous improvement.
  • High Motivation for personal development, willing to take responsibility and get involved while working successfully with a diverse cultural team.
  • Support non-related project tasks to further the development of internal business lines and practices

Why you belong at 4flow

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are a plus.
  • Experience in a technical consulting or software engineering role, with a focus on supply chain, transportation, and logistics software solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with software system architectural design, implementation, and integration in a client-facing role with a strong passion for technology.
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, etc.)
  • Experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and SaaS implementations.
  • Strong understanding of data integration, APIs, and system architecture in a supply chain context.
  • Familiarity with databases, SQL, data governance, monitoring tools, and business intelligence tools
  • Experience with front-end and back-end coding languages: Python, Java, C+, similar enterprise solution languages
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with global teams and clients.
  • Availability to work in a hybrid model at the Campinas office, with a regular monthly office presence.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with SaaS enterprise software delivery in transportation management or network design.
  • Knowledge of advanced technologies (AI/ML, predictive analytics, IoT) in supply chain.
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in software projects.
  • Knowledge of specific logistics systems such as TMS (Transportation Management Systems), Supply Chain Planning Systems (Kinaxis, Logility, SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, or similar), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) systems.

What We Offer
Come join us As part of a highly international, fast-growing company with a vibrant corporate culture, you will enjoy a competitive base salary, an attractive bonus system, and a great benefits package that includes:

  • Caju multi-benefit card
  • Fuel or transportation allowance
  • Comprehensive health and dental plans fully covered for employees and dependents
  • Life insurance
  • Comprehensive well-being initiatives, including Wellhub, our Employee Assistance Program for mental health, and dedicated committees for health and well-being
  • Outstanding opportunities for your individual development (e.g., individual learning budget, access to LinkedIn Learning and internal training program)
  • Hybrid working model for flexibility and work-life balance

And there is more

  • Exciting international projects as well as rapid career development and personal development planning
  • Company with German roots that offers a clearly defined vision and job security
  • Team events and company getaways
  • Free fruit, snacks, drinks, and coffee at the office

Se você busca uma oportunidade para atuar em campo (estradas, cidades e rodovias), desenvolver habilidades técnicas e fazer parte de projetos que impactam diretamente a mobilidade urbana e rodoviária, essa vaga é para você

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar as atividades técnicas de instalação e manutenção de equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos, atuando de forma generalista em campo;
  • Auxiliar na implantação de equipamentos eletrônicos em vias urbanas, estradas e rodovias, dentro e fora da cidade de São Paulo;
  • Prestar suporte em obras urbanas, incluindo escavações, organização do canteiro e sinalização de vias públicas;
  • Apoiar nas operações logísticas, realizando carga e descarga de equipamentos técnicos e operacionais;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time técnico, garantindo organização, segurança e qualidade na execução dos serviços.

Requisitos e Perfil Desejado

  • Residir em Campinas ou ter fácil acesso à região;
  • CNH categoria B ativa;
  • Habilidade com atividades de campo, obras urbanas e manutenção de equipamentos eletrônicos;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de informática;
  • Perfil comprometido, disciplinado e responsável;
  • Foco na execução das tarefas e respeito às normas e hierarquias;
  • Boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e espírito de equipe;
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender e evoluir na área técnica.

O que oferecemos

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Convênio com Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Tíquete Refeição / Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte
  • Programa de Remuneração Variável (bônus anual)

Jornada de Trabalho

  • Segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h às 17h

Modelo de Contratação

  • Efetivo CLT
